{{recipe}}

This '''garlic butter sauce''' is great on filets, seafood, and fried chicken!

== Ingredients ==
* 2 sticks (½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]]) unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], divided
* Splash of heavy [[Cookbook:Cream|cream]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Mincing|minced]] [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
* 1 medium [[Cookbook:Shallot|shallot]], very finely minced
* [[Cookbook:Pinch|Pinch]] of [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] freshly ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]

== Procedure ==
#Melt 2 tbsp butter in large straight-sided [[Cookbook:Sauté Pan|sauté pan]] over medium high heat. Add garlic and shallot, and cook until garlic is golden.
#Add remaining ingredients, and cook just until butter is melted. Remove from heat and allow to come down to room temperature.
#[[Cookbook:Puréeing|Purée]] sauce in batches until smooth. Return to pan and heat through on low heat.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Serve with a steak, some [[Cookbook:Tilapia|tilapia]] or mahimahi, or even fried chicken.
